title: Bluegill Triple Prime object tumbles from fireball
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Bluegill Triple Prime object tumbles from fireball, about October 25, 1962 at Johnston Atoll, Pacific, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: a nuclear test called Blue Guild triple prime was executed it involved a sub Megaton X1 nuclear warhead launched minutes before midnight at Johnston atol in the South Pacific according to many on the ship witnessing the test a bright fiery object tumbled out from the plume of the blast
there are videos of the plume of various detonations where you see the UFOs like there's one uh bluegill triple prime
tellings.difference: Credits Mick West and refers to videos of the plume rather than shipboard witnesses.
tellings.link_reason: Same 1962 Bluegill Triple Prime test, with a UFO seen in the detonation plume.

as_told.title: UFOs seen in nuclear detonation plume (Bluegill Triple Prime)

tellings.quote: and it was it was at midnight and the thing goes off and out of the plume you see this material like tumble out and there's video of this that you can see today and then there's also video of that um you know uh material tumbling out being uh superimposed with a white triangle sanitized
tellings.difference: Adds that the footage still exists and that a sanitized version has a white triangle superimposed on it.
tellings.link_reason: Both are the Bluegill Triple Prime test at Johnston Atoll, where material tumbles from the plume on video, credited to Cruickshank.

as_told.title: Cruickshank footage: material tumbling from nuclear test plume

tellings.quote: You can see clearly from the Kettle 1 footage of the nuclear blast an unidentified flying object tumble out of the nuclear fireball.
tellings.difference: Names the Kettle 1 footage and a Flight Dynamics Laboratory report from Wright-Patterson as sources.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of the object tumbling out of the Bluegill Triple Prime fireball in October 1962.

as_told.title: Kettle 1 footage shows object tumbling out of the Bluegill fireball

tellings.quote: catches wind that in this test a UFO gets knocked out of the comes out of the plume of the nuclear blast
tellings.difference: Told as what Malmgren heard about the test, crediting Malmgren and McNamara rather than Cruickshank, and says the UFO was knocked out of the plume.
tellings.link_reason: Same 1962 Bluegill Triple Prime test at Johnston Atoll, where a UFO comes out of the plume of the nuclear blast.

as_told.title: UFO comes out of the plume in the Bluegill nuclear test

tellings.quote: As in the case of Bluegill Triple Prime, you literally see a video that was taken by, you know, these two crafts, Kettle One and Kettle 2.
tellings.difference: Credits Tim Gallaudet and cites EG&G footage and Navy deck logs.
tellings.link_reason: The same 1962 Bluegill Triple Prime test at Johnston Island, with an object seen in the plume on Kettle 1 and 2 footage.

as_told.title: Bluegill Triple Prime: UFO seen in the nuclear plume

related.note: Both are about the anomalous object seen at the Bluegill Triple Prime test in October 1962. Here it was an object that joined and followed the incoming missile, not material tumbling out of the plume.
